questions.question: The ______ is a famous tower in Paris, France.
questions.explanation: 艾非爾鐵塔 (Eiffel Tower) 位於巴黎。
questions.commonMisconception: 學生可能不清楚世界各大地標的對應城市。

questions.question: People in Japan often eat ______. It's made of rice and fish.
questions.explanation: 由米和魚組成的日本代表性食物是壽司 (sushi)。
questions.commonMisconception: 不熟悉各國飲食文化單字。

questions.question: My friends and I ______ to music every day. We love pop songs.
questions.explanation: 主詞 My friends and I 為複數，接原形動詞 listen。
questions.commonMisconception: 習慣口語忽略 listen 之後通常要加 to，但在這題選項中只需選動詞形態。

questions.question:
A: What ______ you doing last night?
B: I was doing my English homework.
questions.explanation: 過去進行式疑問句，主詞 you 配 were。
questions.commonMisconception: 混淆助動詞 Did 與 B 動詞 Were。

questions.question:
A: Is your father going to watch the game tonight?
B: Yes, ______.
questions.explanation: 主詞 your father 是男性，代名詞用 he，B 動詞對應為 is。
questions.commonMisconception: 代名詞選錯 gender。

questions.question:
A: Do you like to go shopping?
B: No. I ______ it's boring.
questions.explanation: 一般現在式的意見表達，主詞 I 配 think。
questions.commonMisconception: 受 B 的不喜歡影響誤以為要用過去式 thought。

questions.question: In America, students ______ a yellow bus to school.
questions.explanation: 描述一般的習慣或事實，使用現在簡單式，主詞 students 為複數故用 take。
questions.commonMisconception: 受 yellow bus 吸引而忘記動詞與主詞 students 的對應。

questions.question: Lily's uncle ______ to be a pilot when he was young.
questions.explanation: 後半句 when he was young 指出是過去的事，故動詞使用 wanted。
questions.commonMisconception: 習慣性選現在式單三 wants，未讀完後半句線索。

questions.question: We went to a Japanese restaurant ______.
questions.explanation: went 為過去式，時間副詞應選 last night。
questions.commonMisconception: 動詞時態與時間副詞未對應。

questions.question:
Max: 'I am going to New York.' 
Eva: 'I am going to London.' 
Question: Where is Max going?
questions.explanation: New York 位於 USA（美國）。
questions.commonMisconception: 地名與國家名的地理連結力弱。

questions.question:
I play games with my friends on Fridays. I play piano on Saturdays. Today is the first day of the weekend.
Question: What am I doing today?
questions.explanation: 週末的第一天通常指週六 (Saturday)，對應活動為 play piano。
questions.commonMisconception: 文化差異認知（週末首日是週六還是週日），在此語境中指週六。

questions.question:
Menu: Beef Noodles $120, Pizza $150, Sushi $200. 
I have $130. What can I NOT buy?
questions.explanation: 持有 130 元，買不起 200 元的壽司和 150 元的披薩，選項中 Sushi 符合題目。注意問的是 NOT。
questions.commonMisconception: 忽略 NOT 或是數學計算錯誤。

questions.question:
Happy 11th Birthday, Ken! I hope you like the robot I bought for you yesterday. 
Question: How old is Ken today?
questions.explanation: Happy 11th Birthday 指的是 11 歲生日。
questions.commonMisconception: 受 11th 序數詞干擾或受 yesterday 影響。

questions.question:
In some countries, you should not ______ with your fingers. You should use a fork or chopsticks. 
Question: Choose the best words.
questions.explanation: 配餐具（叉子、筷子）的動作是吃 (eat)。
questions.commonMisconception: 不具備詞義關聯推論能力。

questions.question: My cake is big, but your cake is ______ than mine.
questions.explanation: 有 than 出現需用比較級，big 的比較級為 bigger。
questions.commonMisconception: 比較級重複字尾規則不熟。

questions.question: When it is Christmas in Taiwan, the weather is cold. Because it is ______.
questions.explanation: 聖誕節在十二月，季節為冬季 (winter)。
questions.commonMisconception: 月份與季節對應發生錯誤。

questions.question: Next year, I ______ study harder to get good grades.
questions.explanation: Next year 表示未來，助動詞用 will。若選 am 後面需有 going to。
questions.commonMisconception: 未來式結構混淆。

questions.question: In Chinese culture, ______ is a lucky color for Lunar New Year.
questions.explanation: 中國文化中，紅包與新年裝飾常以紅色 (red) 代表幸運。
questions.commonMisconception: 不具備跨文化基礎常識。

questions.question: People in ______ speak English as their first language.
questions.explanation: 加拿大 (Canada) 的主要官方語言之一是英語。
questions.commonMisconception: 國家與官方語言對應知識不足。

questions.question:
A: Look! I got the gold medal in the race.
B: Wow! You are so fast.
Question: What color is the medal?
questions.explanation: 金牌 (gold medal) 是金黃色的 (yellow/gold)。
questions.commonMisconception: 不認識 gold 或是顏色連結錯誤。
